title: Examining Google DeepMind’s AI bioresilience push
slides: What if AI predicts a pandemic before it starts?
DeepMind now models protein mutations at scale.
Their system missed one critical family entirely.
You must verify AI outputs against lab data.
Run a blind test on your own disease model today.
thread_text:
1. What if AI predicts a pandemic before it starts?

DeepMind’s model missed an entire protein family, leaving a blind spot in outbreak detection.

2. Protein mutations at scale

They simulated thousands of variants, but the gap means real-world viruses could slip through.

3. The missing family

That specific group wasn’t in training data—so the AI never learned to flag it as dangerous.

4. Lab data is the truth

Without cross-checking against wet-lab results, the model’s predictions are guesses, not facts.

5. Run a blind test today

Take your own disease model and feed it a control set of known mutations. If it misses one, rewrite the training.

instagram.caption:
Google DeepMind’s system for predicting pandemic protein mutations skipped an entire protein family🧬

That family wasn’t in the training data❌ So the AI never flagged it as dangerous. Real-world pathogens could slip through that gap.

Lab data is the only reality check🧪 Without wet-lab verification, AI predictions are just guesses.

If you run a disease model today, feed it a control set of known mutations. If it misses one, rewrite the training immediately.
